generation_contract.positive_template: One {finish} {material} {form_factor} {object_type}, a household {category}: a compact upright rectangular loudspeaker box, clearly taller than it is wide, standing on its own flat plinth. Its front baffle carries round drivers on the vertical centerline - a large woofer cone low down and a small dome tweeter at the top - with a circular port opening below the woofer. The side, top and back panels are plain and flat with no controls and no cloth.
generation_contract.pose_guard_prompt: Render exactly one object, centered, resting stably on a flat neutral surface against a plain seamless light-gray background. Three-quarter product view with the camera exactly level at the object's own mid-height, looking straight ahead and never downward, so the front and one side are both visible while the object's vertical edges stay parallel to the sides of the frame and its base line stays horizontal. The entire object fits in frame with a clear margin on every side. Physically plausible real-world proportions and construction. Even studio lighting, soft shadow directly beneath the object only. No humans, no hands, no text, no logos, no labels, no screens showing content, no cables trailing out of frame, no reflections of surroundings, no additional objects, no cropping. This is a neutral reconstruction reference for image-to-3D, not an advertisement scene.
